source_row.stem: A hospital monitors hand hygiene compliance through direct observation by trained auditors. A recognized limitation of this method is:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Measuring mainly formal surgical hand scrub technique specifically, rather than routine hand hygiene compliance more broadly across the unit","B":"Producing data considered to be fairly inaccurate in most instances the method is actually used to track compliance","C":"Having fairly little established or recognized use within infection prevention programs across most healthcare settings today","D":"The \"Hawthorne effect,\" where staff may perform better when they know they are being observed, potentially overestimating true compliance"}}
source_row.rationale: Direct observation of hand hygiene compliance carries a recognized limitation known as the "Hawthorne effect," where staff behavior may improve when they know they are being observed, potentially overestimating true, unobserved compliance rates.
source_row.source_name: CDC/WHO — Hand Hygiene Compliance Monitoring Methods
